title: BPW-2026-0549
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0549
RELEASE OF STOP NOTICE – WGJ ENTERPRISES INC DBA PCI
WGJ Enterprises Inc dba PCI is transmitting a Release of Stop Notice in the amount of $49,973.79, for roadway, parking lot, airport striping, markings, signs and accessories in connection with the Highway Safety Improvement Program Cycle 7 Left Turn Signal Modifications. The primary contractor is Crosstown Electrical and Data, Inc.
(C-140920, Communication No. 122750 - Filed September 28, 2026)
summary: Releases a $49,973.79 stop notice that WGJ Enterprises (dba PCI) filed over striping and signage work on the Highway Safety Improvement Program Cycle 7 left-turn signal modifications.
